title: Food and mood
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Have you noticed certain foods affecting your mood or energy during the day?
Why do people often choose comfort food when they are stressed?
Can changing diet meaningfully improve mood, or is that claim often exaggerated?
Should mental-health advice include more discussion of sleep, exercise, and nutrition together?
What is a healthy way to enjoy comfort food without using it as the only response to stress?
